blocks.text: Moviegoers who easily become uncomfortable around spiders and feel immediate discomfort from being trapped in enclosed spaces might want to think twice before watching “Crawlers.” However, those who enjoy the opposite may want to include the film in their Halloween marathon. Directed by Ángel Gómez Hernández, the 2026 horror-thriller follows Serena (Matilda Lutz), an underappreciated building manager at the Paradiso Palms apartment complex, whose already difficult job takes a frightening turn after a resident dies from a mysterious spider infestation. The viral outbreak leads authorities to quarantine the entire building, trapping its residents with a multiplying breed of venomous spiders. With […]...
